study type: Case-control study with in vitro experimentation
cohort: The study included 39 pregnant women with DVT and 39 pregnant women without DVT.
finding: Increased circ_0020123, cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and puerperal bedtime (> 72 hours) were identified as independent risk factors for deep vein thrombosis in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for deep vein thrombosis in pregnant women.
